title: aggregate timezone: the zone resolution rule is written three times (engine, driver-sql, analytics echo) and only two are pinned together
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: an out-of-scope finding the L2 contract-review record 6933599747 on PR #34530 (card #33697) says should get a follow-up card, passed on by area `o2-F`. Dedupe: `echoBucketZone`, `zone resolution three places`.

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#33697 给聚合加了时区分桶。「时区名怎么解析、走哪条路」的规则写了三份：引擎一份、driver-sql 一份、analytics 的 echo 一份。现在只有引擎和 echo 被测试钉在一起，driver-sql 那份可以悄悄漂走。
- 为什么要修：同一条规则三处实现，迟早会分歧，分歧时同一个时区会走不同的路。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

After PR #34530 merges, give the rule one home that all three call, or, if a package boundary forbids one shared call, one shared table and a test that runs every spelling through all three and asserts the same road. L2 N1 (what a non-declaring driver does when a direct caller hands it a zone) goes in the same change if it was not answered in PR #34530.

## Done when

One implementation of the rule, or one conformance test over all three, fails when any one copy drifts.

Blocked-by: #33697
